Maximum capacity (Emax)10 kg
Minimum dead load0 kg
Accuracy ClassC

Ratio of minimum LC Verification interval
Y = Emax / vmin		40000
Ratio of minimum dead load output return
Z = Emax / (2 * DR)		13000
Input impedance405 Ω ± 10 Ω
